GET /accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scori.summary: Get risk event/score information for a specific user
GET /accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scori.description:
Gets the risk level, the last reset time, and the risk events of one user. The server reads
risk events from at most 180 days before the current time, and after the last reset of the user.
Returns 404 when the request reaches a server outside of the configured region of the account.

parameters.name: timestamp.between
parameters.description:
Time range as <start_seconds>:<end_seconds> in Unix epoch seconds. The start must be before
the end.

parameters.name: time_zone
parameters.description: IANA time zone name. The server validates the value. The value does not change the response.
Number of results per page. The server uses 100 for a larger value.
parameters.name: per_page
order_by
parameters.description: Field to sort the events by.

success.description: Whether the API call was successful.

result.description: Risk level, last reset time, and risk events of one user.

events.description: Risk events of the user on this page.

items.description: One risk event of a user.

event_details.description: Details of the event. The fields depend on the behavior. The server omits the field when the details are not valid JSON.

id.description: ID of the behavior that caused the event.

name.description: Name of the behavior that caused the event.
name.example: High number of DLP policies triggered

points.description: Risk score points of a behavior.

risk_level.description: Risk level of a behavior or an event.

last_reset_time.description: Time of the last risk score reset of the user. The value is null when the score was never reset.

risk_level.description: Risk level of a behavior or an event.

result_info.description: Pagination information. The server always returns every field.

count.description: Number of results on this page.

page.description: Current page within the paginated list of results.

total_count.description: Total number of results that match the request.

4XX.description: Failed to get the risk events for the user.

success.description: Whether the API call was successful.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scori.summary: List risk event clusters for a specific user
GET /accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scori.description:
Lists the risk events of one user, grouped by calendar day in the requested time zone. Each
cluster contains at most 25 events, oldest first. The time range is at most 30 days. The server
reads risk events from at most 180 days before the current time.
Returns 404 when the request reaches a server outside of the configured region of the account.

parameters.name: timestamp.between
parameters.description:
Time range as <start_seconds>:<end_seconds> in Unix epoch seconds. The default is the last
7 days. The server returns 400 when the range is longer than 30 days.

parameters.name: time_zone
parameters.description: IANA time zone name that sets the calendar day of each cluster.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of clusters per page. The server uses 10 for a larger value.

200.description: Risk event clusters for the user.

success.description: Whether the API call was successful.

result.description: Risk level, last reset time, and daily risk event clusters of one user.

clusters.description: Daily risk event clusters on this page.

items.description: The risk events of one user on one calendar day.

end_time.description: End of the calendar day of the cluster, in the requested time zone.

event_count.description: Number of events in the cluster.

events.description: At most 25 events of the cluster, oldest first.

items.description: One risk event of a user.

event_details.description: Details of the event. The fields depend on the behavior. The server omits the field when the details are not valid JSON.

id.description: ID of the behavior that caused the event.

name.description: Name of the behavior that caused the event.
name.example: High number of DLP policies triggered

points.description: Risk score points of a behavior.

risk_level.description: Risk level of a behavior or an event.

first_event_time.description: Time of the first event in the cluster.

highest_risk_level.description: Highest risk level. The value is unset when no event maps to a configured behavior.

last_event_time.description: Time of the last event in the cluster.

points.description: Sum of the points of all events in the cluster.

start_time.description: Start of the calendar day of the cluster, in the requested time zone.

last_reset_time.description: Time of the last risk score reset of the user. The value is null when the score was never reset.

range_event_count.description: Number of events in the requested time range.

risk_level.description: Risk level of a behavior or an event.

result_info.description: Pagination information. The server always returns every field.

count.description: Number of results on this page.

page.description: Current page within the paginated list of results.

total_count.description: Total number of results that match the request.

4XX.description: Failed to get the risk event clusters for the user.

success.description: Whether the API call was successful.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scori.summary: Get all behaviors and associated configuration
GET /accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scori.description:
Gets all risk behaviors for an account and their configuration. The response omits a disabled
behavior when the account does not have the gates or entitlements for that behavior.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scori.summary: Get risk score info for all users in the account
GET /accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scori.description:
Gets the users in an account that have risk events, with the highest risk level, the event
count, and the time of the last event for each user. The server reads risk events from at most
180 days before the current time, and after the last reset of each user.
Returns 404 when the request reaches a server outside of the configured region of the account.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scor.summary: Clear the risk score for a particular user
POST /accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scor.description:
Resets the risk score of one user. Risk events before the reset do not count toward the score
of the user.

200.description: The risk score of the user is reset. The result is null.

success.description: Whether the API call was successful.

4XX.description: Failed to reset the risk score of the user.

success.description: Whether the API call was successful.

PUT /accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scori.description:
Updates the configuration of one or more risk behaviors for an account. The server skips an
unknown behavior, and a behavior that the account does not have the gates or entitlements for.
The response contains all behaviors for the account.

schema.description: Settings for one or more risk behaviors, keyed by behavior ID.

behaviors.description: Settings for each behavior to update, keyed by behavior ID.

additionalProperties.description:
Settings for one risk behavior. Supply risk_level, points, or both. When you supply both,
points must be in the range of risk_level. When you supply only one, the server derives the
other.

enabled.description: Whether the behavior counts toward the risk score.

points.description: Risk score points of the behavior. A null value is the same as an omitted value.

risk_level.description: Risk level of a behavior or an event.

200.description: Risk behaviors for the account after the update.

success.description: Whether the API call was successful.

result.description: Risk behaviors, keyed by behavior ID.

behaviors.description: Risk behaviors, keyed by behavior ID.
